fields.Name: T380 - Sign Out Returns To Login
fields.Description: Exercises the authentication teardown path (userMenu Sign Out -> onLogout -> authBase.logout + auth cache clear) — the only test that exits the authenticated session.

InputDefinition.goal: You are logged in at http://localhost:4200. Click the user avatar button in the TOP-RIGHT corner of the header to open the user menu, then click the 'Sign Out' (logout) item. Verify the application tears down the session and returns to the sign-in / login screen (an auth prompt or login button appears). Seeing the app leave the authenticated shell and land on the login screen is success — you do NOT need to log back in. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The user menu shows a 'Sign Out' / logout item
Clicking it leaves the authenticated Explorer shell (header/tabs no longer shown)
A login / sign-in screen or auth prompt is presented
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
